prompt: Create a production texture atlas for a first-person dark, damp golf-course horror game, Under the Green. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-resolution HAND-PIXELLED architectural material color atlas, square 2048x2048 if possible, exactly FOUR equal square quadrants in a 2x2 arrangement, no gutters, borders, text, labels, perspective, objects, vignette or scene lighting. Each quadrant is a separate perfectly straight-on, seamless repeating surface spanning approximately two metres square. Top left: aged dark umber / muted olive-brown drainage brick, 8 horizontal courses, about 4 staggered bricks across, narrow deeply recessed dark mortar, slightly uneven chipped stone edges, a few broad quiet damp discolorations. Top right: coordinated variant of the same brickwork, same course/brick scale, subtly different brick proportions/chipped corners and restrained dark repairs; no conspicuous repeated stain or large symbol. Bottom left: old poured concrete, smoky warm gray with subtle irregular clouded cement fields, occasional sparse small chips and hairline stepped cracks; continuous quiet surface with NO slab grid and NO bolts. Bottom right: old glazed ceramic square tiles, muted warm gray / pale sage, 8 tiles across and 8 down, thin dirty grout, subtle glaze variations, only a few fine crazed or chipped edges. ART DIRECTION CRITICAL: exquisite high-resolution PIXEL ART with intentional crisp connected pixel clusters, limited coordinated earth-tone palette, stepped contours, subtle ordered shading. Rich material craftsmanship, restrained 2-to-8-pixel detail clusters over broad quiet midtone areas. No photographic micrograin, no random one-pixel salt-and-pepper noise, no white lichen crust covering every brick, no thick moss, no roots, no neon/cyan, no glossy baked-in reflections, no oversharpened photorealism, no cartoon outlines. About 65 percent of each material should be quiet, matte color fields so actual 3D lighting, roots, mud and props can carry the scene. Brick texture should still look old, damp, heavy and unsettling, not clean or newly built. Preserve clear distinction between brick / concrete / ceramic in grayscale. Even diffuse ambient illumination, no cast shadows. Seamless opposite edges per quadrant; identical size and pixel density in both brick variants.
